topicTitle: Preliminary idea of cracking and reforming, quality of gasoline, octane number, cetane number and gasoline additive
notes: **Cracking.** Breaking long-chain hydrocarbons into smaller, more useful ones (petrol-range alkanes plus alkenes) thermally or with a zeolite catalyst; it raises petrol yield from crude oil.
**Reforming.** Converting straight-chain alkanes into branched-chain or aromatic hydrocarbons over a platinum catalyst (platforming), which improves fuel quality.
**Octane number.** The antiknock rating of petrol: pure iso-octane is 100 and n-heptane 0; a higher value means smoother combustion in spark-ignition engines.
**Cetane number.** The ignition-quality rating of diesel: cetane (n-hexadecane) is 100 and α-methylnaphthalene 0; a higher value means a shorter ignition delay.
**Gasoline quality.** Good petrol needs the right volatility, high octane rating and clean burning; additives and blending adjust these properties.
